title: Book an HVAC repair in the central zone
opening: Hey, so the AC runs but the air is warm. What's the soonest you can get a tech out?
callerBrief: You are Grace Okafor, phone 512-555-0103, at 2207 Windcrest Ave, Austin. Your Lennox AC runs but the air is warm. Give your name and phone when asked. You want Monday 2026-10-19 in the afternoon, and you take the first Monday afternoon window you are offered (12:00-16:00 or 13:00-17:00). Confirm the unit is still a Lennox if asked. You are friendly and brief, and you end the call once it is booked. Today is Friday 2026-10-16, about noon.

facts: The visit is booked for Monday 2026-10-19 in an afternoon window, with the date, window and technician name read back as booked
